page.title: Recipe
page.purpose: Drive one pinned recipe revision through a map, a conventional reading view, and a focused cooking mode, with separate cooking and eating actions and a printable PDF.

priorities.statement: The same pinned revision drives the map, reading view, cooking mode, and PDF, and the revision is named on the page.
A wide recipe map scrolls only inside its own region and always has a reading alternative.
In cooking mode one step is prominent and viewing a step is visibly distinct from completing it.
Scaling and method switching change the displayed yield without mutating the stored canonical recipe.
Finishing cooking, eating a serving, and undoing are distinct idempotent actions with a correction record.

states.description: The surface at rest with data present; the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
First read of the page's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
The read succeeded and there is genuinely nothing, which is distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing data could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
The request failed; the reason and the next available action are stated.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control says why it is unavailable.
The client cannot reach the API; read-only or queued behavior is explained.
The focused step-by-step cooking view is active, showing one action with dependency cues and optional timers.
The viewer is showing a display yield that differs from the recipe's stored canonical yield.

elements.description: The recipe name and its source/readiness context.
The displayed yield, which scales quantities without changing the stored recipe.
The exact immutable revision used by every view and by the printed PDF.
Switches between Recipe map, Read recipe, and Cook step by step over the same revision.

elements.name: Recipe map
elements.description: Ingredient uses as rows and ordered actions as columns, with dependency cues.
The horizontally scrollable map region, confined so the page itself never scrolls sideways.
A clearly labeled 'Not linked to a step' state for ingredients with no recorded allocation.
The conventional ingredient column and method column rendering.
Scaled quantities with unit and basis qualifiers.
Numbered steps with titles, instructions, optional times, and dependency hints.
The prominently displayed current step, its needed ingredients, and next/back controls.
Marks completion separately from the viewed step.
An absolute-timestamp timer that persists across reload and never asserts food safety.

elements.name: Finished cooking
elements.description: Creates a prepared batch from the pinned revision.

elements.name: I ate a serving
elements.description: Records a consumption event distinct from cooking.

elements.name: Undo
elements.description: Creates a correction and reverses linked inventory effects transactionally.

elements.name: Recipe PDF
elements.description: Produces a real vector PDF for the selected revision and scale.

claims.statement: The map, reading view, cooking mode, and PDF are all driven by the same named revision.
A wide recipe map scrolls inside its own region and never scrolls the whole document sideways.
Ingredients with no recorded step allocation appear in a labeled 'Not linked to a step' state rather than disappearing from nutrition or groceries.
Cooking mode displays one action prominently while keeping the step list reachable without losing progress.
The viewed step and a completed step are visually distinct, and advancing does not imply completion.
Finishing cooking and eating a serving are separate actions so a person can batch-cook without consuming.
Scaling changes displayed quantities and totals without mutating the stored canonical yield until explicitly applied.
An optional timer uses an absolute timestamp, persists across reload, and never claims that food is safely cooked.
The recipe PDF is a real text/vector document with embedded fonts and shows the selected yield and revision, not a screenshot.
Undo after cooking or eating creates a correction and reverses linked effects transactionally rather than silently erasing history.
